purpose: Re-run hierarchy overlap and cycle validation whenever an effective-dated placement changes its parent organization unit.
lockImpact: Takes the table lock required to drop and recreate one trigger definition in the same migration transaction; no rows or indexes are rewritten. Runtime hierarchy writes retain the existing transaction-scoped advisory lock.
dataImpact: Destructively replaces one trigger object in the same transaction but does not delete or rewrite organization facts.
backfill: Not required because existing writes could not change the parent through the module store; operators should run the documented hierarchy integrity checks before applying if direct SQL access was previously used.
destructiveApproval: Approved only for the transactional replacement of organization_unit_placements_no_overlap; the migration drops no table, row, index, schema, or persisted organization fact.
recovery: A failure rolls back both trigger statements. After a committed migration, forward-fix the trigger definition in a later reviewed migration; do not remove hierarchy validation after application writes resume.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed organization-owned migration for any later trigger or hierarchy-constraint repair.
